study.scope: Exploratory leave-one-recording-out folds using only original training recordings from one person/session. Prior recordings and v1 outcomes have been inspected.
study.label_access: Only eligible labels strictly before 10 seconds of the held-out recording. Identical prefix labels for calibrated ridge and prefix constants. No later labels enter fitting or calibration.

integrity_definition: SHA-256 parameter and prediction digests prove repeatability without publishing coefficients or per-sample predictions.
